name: @sprite-foundry/fantasy-heroes-48
description: Fantasy Heroes — Pack 03 | 16 hero archetypes × 8 directions × 3 layers | 48px pixel-art sprite pack
author: mcp-tool-shop

scripts.verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./pack.json');let ok=true;for(const v of p.variants){const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(v.path,'utf8'));for(const d of m.directions){for(const[l,pat]of Object.entries(m.layers)){const f=v.path.replace('manifest.json','')+pat.replace('{direction}',d);if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('MISSING:',f);ok=false}}}}if(ok){console.log('All assets verified')}else{process.exit(1)}"
